_comment: A public type that cannot hold a service keeps the service out of the API: a variable holding a service and then a record of strings is passed as ConfigProvider.fromEnvRecord's Record<string, string | undefined>, and a variable holding a service and then a boolean is handed back by a predicate through Option.exists, declared to return a boolean, whose result's keys are read. Each read method stays; each service's unread method is removed. Guards the type-bound filter's precision on parameters and returns.
